title: Guideline files in the cloud (schema version 2)
description:
The cloud stores the GUIDELINE.md files themselves in S3 with the catalog row holding version, who, when, why and a hash over the set. papyrus guidelines save --kind writing --dir uploads the set as a new version (stale versions refused); export --dir writes back byte-identical files. The resolver, layering, section-never-loosens, admin-only saving and derived checks stay. Today's structured fields (voice, audience, tone, lexicon, glossary, headline, constraints) become guideline files with fixed names; schema version 2 of the writing document is converted once per site by a command, then the JSON reader is removed. Decision accepted by Ryan 2026-11-16: yes. Changes what PPY-2a2a8a built.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Gherkin: Save and export round trip (byte-identical; stale version refused).
- Gherkin: Layering.
- Gherkin: Derived checks (each error or warn file derives one check; hand-written checks never touched).
- Gherkin: One-time conversion of each site's JSON document to files, with the resolved result unchanged.
- No reader for both shapes remains.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.
